standard_prerequisites.name: The inclusion between the stalk of the annihilator ideal and the annihilator of the stalk, valid without any finiteness hypothesis
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The displayed inclusion referred to in the counted proof (source lines 4139 and 4119) is an earlier labelled equation of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the statement to the reverse inclusion, which is what the proof establishes.

standard_prerequisites.name: The injectivity of the canonical map from the stalk of the sheaf of homomorphisms into the homomorphisms of the stalks for a module of finite type
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 4131-4135) as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the vanishing of a section on the stalk into its vanishing on a neighbourhood.

core_obligations: Use the injectivity on the sheaf of homomorphisms: for a module of finite type the canonical map from the stalk of the sheaf of endomorphisms to the endomorphisms of the stalk is injective (proof lines 4131-4135)

Spread the vanishing: hence a local section of the structure sheaf which acts as zero on the stalk of the module acts as zero on the restriction of the module to some smaller neighbourhood of the point (proof lines 4136-4138)
Conclude equality: therefore every element of the annihilator of the stalk lies in the stalk of the annihilator ideal, so the displayed inclusion is an equality (proof lines 4139-4140)
proof_roadmap: 由 lemma-stalk-internal-hom（F 有限型），Hom_O(F,F)_x → Hom_{O_{X,x}}(F_x,F_x) 单射。
于是若截面 f 在 F_x 上为零，则它在某个更小邻域 V 上零化 F|_V，即 f ∈ Ann(F)_x；故包含式 (\ref{equation-inclusion-of-annihilator-ideals}) 取等。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement computes the stalk of the annihilator ideal of a module of finite type as the annihilator of its stalk (author lemma at source lines 4121-4128, label lemma-finite-type-annihilator-stalk). The proof (source lines 4130-4141) invokes the injectivity of the canonical map on the sheaf of endomorphisms for a module of finite type, which turns the vanishing of a section on the stalk into its vanishing on a neighbourhood, and concludes that the known inclusion is an equality (proof lines 4131-4140). The use of the injectivity to spread the vanishing is the content. H2.
